title: Jonah and the Garden
author: August Blackwood
blurb: Tamsin Thornbury, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
